purpose: Use only H10N1 and H10S2 to test whether the later approximately 12-13 dB broadband S2-over-N1 offset is observable anywhere in the public EarthScope archive before the documented 2013-07-19 H10S fault anchor, without requiring all six HA10 channels to be simultaneously available.
why_pair_only: The six-channel archive-wide value-blind gate found its earliest simultaneous all-six probe only on 2014-12-12, which is after the 2013 fault anchor. The scientific question about preexistence of the S2/N1 offset does not logically require N2/N3/S1/S3; those channels are required only for the stronger crosstalk morphology discriminator.

discovery_contract.earliest_probe_day_rule: Choose the chronologically earliest daily 12:00 UTC one-second probe before 2013-07-19 for which both H10N1 and H10S2 are returned on the same date. No failed transport chunk may be skipped.
discovery_contract.full_window_freeze_rule: From the earliest pair date move strictly forward by UTC day, never crossing 2013-07-19, and freeze the first 20 12:00-12:10 UTC windows complete on both channels using headers only.

predeclared_classification.PRE2013_LARGE_OFFSET_SIMILAR_TO_2014: pre-2013 raw median >=6 dB and within 3 dB of the frozen 2014 raw median
predeclared_classification.PRE2013_OFFSET_MATERIALLY_LOWER_THAN_201: pre-2013 raw median <6 dB while frozen 2014 median >=6 dB
